title: Answer: a self is a perspective within cosmic subjectivity

statements.text: A self is a local subject, a thing there is something it is like to be. On Shani and Keppler’s view each perspectival self appropriates a portion of the universal subjective medium and becomes an ego aware of its objects and unaware of its unity with other selves and the ground of being. On Goff’s view it is an aspect of the cosmic subject or a subject emerging from it.

sources.quote: each of them appropriates to itself a selective portion of this universal
Conscious subjects are the bearers of phenomenal properties
